What we do

Cleaning services for homes, rentals & businesses

One local team for the jobs that matter most — from fast vacation rental turnovers between guests to recurring commercial cleaning on a schedule you can set and forget.

Vacation Rental Turnovers

Fast, thorough turnovers between guests: kitchens and bathrooms sanitized, beds made with fresh linens, floors cleaned, and every detail checked so your next guests walk into a spotless home.

For: Airbnb & VRBO hosts, rental managers

Commercial Cleaning

Recurring cleaning for offices and businesses — daily, weekly, or on your schedule. Consistent crews, a written scope of work, and a space that always looks ready for customers and staff.

For: offices, restaurants, shops, clinics

Deep Cleans

The top-to-bottom reset: inside your appliances, baseboards, grout, vents, and all the spots regular cleaning misses. Perfect before guests, after a busy season, or whenever a home needs a fresh start.

For: homeowners, hosts, one-time jobs

Move-In / Move-Out Cleans

Empty-home cleaning that gets a place truly ready for what's next — inside cabinets and appliances, walls spot-cleaned, and floors left spotless. Built for smooth handoffs and deposit-ready results.

For: tenants, landlords, property managers

Window Cleaning

Interior and exterior window cleaning for homes and businesses. Streak-free glass, wiped sills and tracks — so all that Central Oregon light can pour back in.

For: homes, rentals, storefronts, offices

Junk Removal

Old furniture, appliances, remodel debris, garage cleanouts — we haul it away and leave the space clean. A simple add-on to a move-out or deep clean, or a job on its own.

For: cleanouts, move-outs, remodels

Event Cleaning

Before and after the big day: pre-event prep so the space is spotless when your guests arrive, and post-event cleanup — trash hauled out, floors, kitchens, and bathrooms back to normal — so you get to enjoy the event too.

For: weddings, parties, corporate events, venues

Trash Bin Cleaning

Your trash and recycling bins, washed, sanitized, and deodorized — inside and out. We blast away the grime, bacteria, and smells that build up in the bin, so it comes back clean instead of holding its breath every time you open it.

For: homes, vacation rentals, HOAs, businesses

Snow Removal

When winter hits Central Oregon, we keep your property safe and accessible: snow cleared from driveways, walkways, sidewalks, and parking lots — so guests, customers, and family can come and go without the slip-and-slide.

For: homes, vacation rentals, businesses — seasonal service

Our story

Built from the ground up, one home at a time

Yenny's Cleaning didn't start with investors or a franchise. It started with its owners spending two years working for someone else — cleaning homes and learning the standards, the little details, and what great service really looks like. They learned everything they could along the way, all with one goal in mind: starting a business of their own.

Then, in 2022, the three owners took the leap and founded their own company — Yenny's Cleaning, LLC. They started out with residential homes, then made the jump into commercial cleaning — earning every new client by doing the previous job right.

Today, Yenny's Cleaning serves businesses and private clients across Bend and Sunriver. And one thing has never changed: an unwavering focus on quality work and great care for every customer, on every visit.

  1. Two years learning the trade

    The owners spent two years working for someone else, learning everything they could — the standards, the details, and how to take great care of customers.

  2. Founded in 2022 — three owners start their own company

    With that experience behind them, the three owners founded Yenny's Cleaning, LLC in Bend — their own clients, their own standards — starting out with residential homes.

  3. From homes to commercial work

    After getting started with residential homes, the company made the jump into commercial cleaning.

  4. Today

    Yenny's Cleaning serves businesses and private clients across Central Oregon — still focused on quality work and great customer care on every visit.
